dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: The skill supplies concrete, AWS‑specific decision trees, exact CLI probe commands, recent feature nuances (e.g., MSK Connect custom‑plugin limits, IAM auth v2 actions) and a mapping of 9 symptom categories to root causes. This goes beyond generic Kafka Connect knowledge a baseline model would have.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Procedures are tightly scoped to AWS services (e.g., `aws kafkaconnect describe-connector`, `aws iam simulate-principal-policy`, SG egress checks) and follow a logical order (pre‑flight gate → category‑specific probe → remediation). No generic "check logs" steps remain.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: The NEVER section lists many concrete anti‑patterns with explicit rationales (e.g., never restart without reading trace because the same record will fail again). Each warning is tied to a real AWS/Connect failure mode.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Front‑matter is complete, activation triggers, when_to_use/when_not_to_use, and a precise invocation_schema are present. The only minor gap is the lack of an explicit versioned schema for the output block, but activation criteria are clear.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: The document layers information: a high‑level overview, quick‑reference tables, then deep dive sections. Critical rules (NEVER) and detailed probes are hidden until the reader navigates to the relevant step, avoiding cognitive overload.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: All potentially destructive actions (e.g., `update-connector`, `delete-connector`) are gated behind explicit operator approval and safety checks. Creative tasks (diagnosis) are given full freedom, while state‑changing commands are tightly constrained.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: The skill follows a recognizable pattern: Mindset → Quick reference → Pre‑flight → Decision tree → Anti‑patterns → Heuristics → Recent features. Structure is consistent and aids comprehension.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides concrete CLI probes, worked examples, and exact output contract, enabling an agent to act. Lacks handling for pagination, error‑code branches, and fallback when probes fail beyond NEED_MORE_INFO, which prevents a perfect score.
